verdict.rationale: Langfuse is open source (MIT license), self-hostable on your own infrastructure, and provides Blob Storage Export for bulk data, plus Metrics API, SDK query access, and OTLP endpoints for data extraction, giving strong open-format export and full data ownership. missing for 10: no explicit documented one-click 'export all data and leave' workflow, no independent/hands-on confirmation of export completeness or format fidelity, and one enterprise feature (data retention policies) is gated behind a license key.
